Modals

Page content sits behind the modal. When the dialog opens it's dimmed by the overlay and made inert; focus moves into the dialog, Tab is trapped within it, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger.

Confirm payment

You're about to send £250.00 to Jordan Lee. This can't be undone once confirmed.

Input-fields

Boxed field

Full-border field (Figma 65570:211753). The GBP prefix, trailing icon and (?) help are optional. Active & error states add a 4px bottom-stroke emphasis; the error message uses text/default so it stays legible (rag/error red is reserved for the stroke + alert icon).

    Accordion

    Go to Payments → Standing orders → New, choose the payee and amount, and set the frequency and start date.
    Daily limits depend on your account type and verification status. See Settings → Limits for your current allowances.

    Tooltip

    The trigger sits at the end of a label (never inside body text). Hover or tab to the icon; the tip flips above/below and shifts left/right to stay on-screen. Try the ones near the top and right edges.

    Available balance The funds you can spend right now, after pending transactions are deducted.
    Interest rate (AER) Annual Equivalent Rate — shows the interest if it were paid and compounded once each year.
    Sort code The six-digit number that identifies your bank and branch.
